chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.1 Integer | 1.1 Integers
text: Integer ialah nombor bulat yang mempunyai tanda positif atau negatif, termasuk sifar.
text_en: Integers are whole numbers with positive or negative signs, including zero.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.1 Integer | 1.1 Integers
text: Integer positif adalah nombor bulat yang lebih besar daripada sifar, manakala integer negatif kurang daripada sifar.
text_en: Positive integers are whole numbers greater than zero, while negative integers are less than zero.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.1 Integer | 1.1 Integers
text: Sifar bukan integer positif mahupun integer negatif.
text_en: Zero is neither a positive nor a negative integer.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.1 Integer | 1.1 Integers
text: Sumeria Purba menggunakan konsep pengiraan asas sebelum integer negatif diiktiraf secara meluas oleh ahli matematik India.
text_en: Ancient Sumerians used basic counting concepts before negative integers were widely recognized by Indian mathematicians.

topic: 1.2 Operasi Asas Aritmetik yang Melibatkan Integer | 1.2 Basic Arithmetic Operations Involving Integers
text: Operasi penambahan, penolakan, pendaraban, dan pembahagian integer mengikut tatatanda tanda dan hukum kalis tukar tertib, kalis sekutuan, serta kalis agihan.
text_en: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of integers follow sign rules and commutative, associative, and distributive laws.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.2 Operasi Asas Aritmetik yang Melibatkan Integer | 1.2 Basic Arithmetic Operations Involving Integers
text: Pendaraban dua nombor bertanda sama menghasilkan nilai positif, manakala tanda berbeza menghasilkan nilai negatif.
text_en: Multiplication of two numbers with the same sign yields a positive value, while different signs yield a negative value.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.2 Operasi Asas Aritmetik yang Melibatkan Integer | 1.2 Basic Arithmetic Operations Involving Integers
text: Tertib operasi (BODMAS) mesti dipatuhi semasa menyelesaikan ungkapan aritmetik.
text_en: The order of operations (BODMAS) must be followed when solving arithmetic expressions.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.2 Operasi Asas Aritmetik yang Melibatkan Integer | 1.2 Basic Arithmetic Operations Involving Integers
text: Memperkenalkan peraturan matematik formal untuk pengiraan integer termasuk penambahan dan penolakan sifar.
text_en: Introduced formal mathematical rules for integer calculations including addition and subtraction of zero.

text: Pecahan positif dan negatif diwakilkan pada garis nombor untuk membandingkan nilainya.
text_en: Positive and negative fractions are represented on a number line to compare their values.

text: Pecahan positif terletak di sebelah kanan sifar, manakala pecahan negatif di sebelah kiri sifar.
text_en: Positive fractions lie to the right of zero, while negative fractions lie to the left of zero.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.3 Pecahan Positif dan Pecahan Negatif | 1.3 Positive and Negative Fractions
text: Membandingkan dua pecahan memerlukan penyebut yang sama.
text_en: Comparing two fractions requires a common denominator.

topic: 1.3 Pecahan Positif dan Pecahan Negatif | 1.3 Positive and Negative Fractions
text: Papirus Rhind menunjukkan penggunaan pecahan unit oleh masyarakat Mesir Purba.
text_en: The Rhind Papyrus shows the use of unit fractions by Ancient Egyptians.

topic: 1.4 Perpuluhan Positif dan Perpuluhan Negatif | 1.4 Positive and Negative Decimals
text: Nombor perpuluhan negatif semakin kecil nilainya apabila digitnya semakin jauh dari sifar.
text_en: Negative decimal numbers decrease in value as their digits move further away from zero.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.4 Perpuluhan Positif dan Perpuluhan Negatif | 1.4 Positive and Negative Decimals
text: Pendaraban perpuluhan dikira mengikut bilangan tempat perpuluhan.
text_en: Multiplication of decimals is calculated according to the total number of decimal places.

topic: 1.4 Perpuluhan Positif dan Perpuluhan Negatif | 1.4 Positive and Negative Decimals
text: Membangunkan penggunaan titik perpuluhan dalam pengiraan matematik moden.
text_en: Developed the use of the decimal point in modern mathematical calculations.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.5 Nombor Nisbah | 1.5 Rational Numbers
text: Nombor nisbah ialah nombor yang boleh ditulis dalam bentuk p/q, dengan p dan q ialah integer dan q ≠ 0.
text_en: Rational numbers are numbers that can be written in the form p/q, where p and q are integers and q ≠ 0.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.5 Nombor Nisbah | 1.5 Rational Numbers
text: Semua integer dan pecahan wajar mahupun tak wajar merupakan nombor nisbah.
text_en: All integers and proper or improper fractions are rational numbers.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.5 Nombor Nisbah | 1.5 Rational Numbers
text: Nombor perpuluhan berulang dan perpuluhan tamat tergolong dalam nombor nisbah.
text_en: Terminating and repeating decimals belong to the set of rational numbers.

chapter: Bab 1: Nombor Nisbah | Chapter 1: Rational Numbers
topic: 1.5 Nombor Nisbah | 1.5 Rational Numbers
text: Mengkaji hubungan antara nombor dan nisbah dalam alam semesta.
text_en: Studied the relationships between numbers and ratios in the physical universe.

chapter: Bab 2: Faktor dan Gandaan | Chapter 2: Factors and Multiples
topic: 2.1 Faktor, Faktor Perdana dan Faktor Sepunya Terbesar (FSTB) | 2.1 Factors, Prime Factors and Highest Common Factor (HCF)
text: Faktor ialah nombor membahagi habis nombor tertentu, manakala FSTB ialah faktor sepunya terbesar bagi dua atau lebih nombor.
text_en: Factors are numbers that divide a given number completely, while HCF is the largest common factor of two or more numbers.

chapter: Bab 2: Faktor dan Gandaan | Chapter 2: Factors and Multiples
topic: 2.1 Faktor, Faktor Perdana dan Faktor Sepunya Terbesar (FSTB) | 2.1 Factors, Prime Factors and Highest Common Factor (HCF)
text: Nombor perdana hanya mempunyai dua faktor: 1 dan dirinya sendiri.

chapter: Bab 2: Faktor dan Gandaan | Chapter 2: Factors and Multiples

text: FSTB boleh ditentukan melalui kaedah pembahagian berulang atau pemfaktoran perdana.
text_en: HCF can be determined using repeated division or prime factorization methods.

text_en: Properties of prime numbers were systematically studied in Elements by Euclid.

text_en: A multiple of a number is the product of that number and another whole number, while LCM is the smallest common multiple.

chapter: Bab 2: Faktor dan Gandaan | Chapter 2: Factors and Multiples
topic: 2.2 Gandaan, Gandaan Sepunya dan Gandaan Sepunya Terkecil (GSTK) | 2.2 Multiples, Common Multiples and Lowest Common Multiple (LCM)
text: Setiap nombor mempunyai bilangan gandaan yang tidak terhingga.
text_en: Every number has an infinite number of multiples.

chapter: Bab 2: Faktor dan Gandaan | Chapter 2: Factors and Multiples

text_en: LCM is used to find the lowest common denominator when adding fractions.

topic: 3.1 Kuasa Dua dan Punca Kuasa Dua | 3.1 Squares and Square Roots
text: Kuasa dua suatu nombor ialah hasil darab nombor itu dengan dirinya sendiri, manakala punca kuasa dua ialah operasi songsangannya.
text_en: The square of a number is the product of the number multiplied by itself, while the square root is its inverse operation.

text_en: The square of any real number is always positive or zero.
